description_en: Retrieves the total emissions for various environmental impact categories
description_zh: 获取各种环境影响排放总量
name: GetEpdSummary

parameters.help_en: The product type. \`1\` indicates a product carbon footprint request. \`5\` indicates a supply chain carbon footprint request
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型：1表示请求产品碳足迹，5表示请求供应链碳足迹
parameters.name: product_type

carbonEmission.description_en: The emission amount. The result is returned with 31 decimal places to ensure calculation accuracy. Truncate this value for display. Use the emission amount with its corresponding unit
carbonEmission.description_zh: 排放量。为了保证中间过程的计算精度，结果值保留31位小数，推荐进行截取显示。排放量应配合环境影响结果值单位使用

indicator.description_en: The evaluation indicator for the environmental impact
indicator.description_zh: 该环境影响采用的评价指标

key.description_en: The category key for the environmental impact category. Up to 19 categories are supported. For more information, see the appendix (https://carbon-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/%E7%A2%B3%E8%B6%B3%E8%BF%B9%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95.pdf)
key.description_zh: 类别key。环境影响类别，目前最多支持19类，参考附录 (https://carbon-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/%E7%A2%B3%E8%B6%B3%E8%BF%B9%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95.pdf)

method.description_en: The standard for the calculation method

num.description_en: The category number. This is the unique ordinal number for the environmental impact category. Up to 19 categories are supported. For more information, see the appendix (https://carbon-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/%E7%A2%B3%E8%B6%B3%E8%BF%B9%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95.pdf)
num.description_zh: 类别num，环境影响类别唯一序号，目前最多支持19类，参考附录 (https://carbon-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/%E7%A2%B3%E8%B6%B3%E8%BF%B9%E9%99%84%E5%BD%95.pdf)

preUnit.description_en: The unit of the environmental impact result

state.description_en: The status of the data. \`1\` indicates an accurate calculation. \`2\` indicates that default data was used. \`3\` indicates that a factor was missing and a value of 0 was used
state.description_zh: 数据状态。1表示准确计算，2表示采用默认数据，3表示缺少因子采用0值

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This value is unique for each request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题
